annotations.title: Counterparty risk check: screen a payee's EVM address before paying (OFAC and on-chain signals)

description: Screen a payee before paying, trading or onboarding: one call vets an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism with an OFAC SDN match, account type and activity, USD holdings and, on Base, wallet or contract risk checks; add the payee's domain for its age and trust flags. One block, review or pass verdict with reasons. Screening aid, not legal advice or a security audit. Use before paying, trading with or onboarding an address. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

domain.description: Optional: the payee's domain or website URL, e.g. ethereum.org; adds domain age and trust flags
